description: Kid Space is an immersive collaborative play-based learning environment developed by Aslan et al.
title: Kid Space

description: A manualized school-readiness intervention developed by Pears and colleagues that combines child groups and parent groups to support children with developmental disabilities or delays entering kindergarten.
title: Kids in Transition to School (KITS) Program

description: A Bavarian preschool programme run as a model project that combines play-based early-childhood education with integrated literacy, mathematics, and science stimulation, team teaching with primary-school teachers, and specialized teacher training and materials.
title: KiDZ – Kindergarten of the Future in Bavaria preschool model project

description: KinderTEK is an iPad-delivered mathematics intervention for kindergarten students developed and studied by Lina Shanley and colleagues.
title: KinderTEK

description: A Kinect-based educational environment described by Si (2014) that enables young children to learn and practise Chinese language and cultural skills through multimodal sensor input.
title: Kinect-sensor environment for young children to learn and practice Chinese

description: A set of early group-administered school assessments measuring primary-grade intelligence, class mental status and educational attainments, and seventh-grade subject attainments.
title: Kingsbury pictorial primary scale, Pintner combined mental-educational survey test, and Pressey seventh-grade attainment scale

description: KIPP is a network of public charter schools operated by the KIPP Foundation and affiliated local KIPP organizations, serving students through its school model.
title: KIPP

description: A KIPP programme that prepares new principals to lead new KIPP schools.
title: KIPP Fisher Fellowship

description: A dataset compiled by Thomas Coen and colleagues tracking 1,177 applicants to 13 oversubscribed KIPP middle schools through admissions lotteries and subsequent college enrollment and persistence outcomes.
title: KIPP middle school college-outcome tracking dataset

description: KIPP middle schools are public charter schools operated by the Knowledge Is Power Program (KIPP) network, which runs schools serving primarily underserved students across the United States.
title: KIPP middle schools

description: A pre-kindergarten programme offered and operated by the KIPP charter-school network for young children entering KIPP schools.
title: KIPP Pre-K

description: A dataset of 109 instructor-verified questions and reference answers drawn from an Introduction to AI course's lecture slides and textbook, created for evaluating educational question-answering systems.
title: KITE evaluation dataset of 109 instructor-verified questions from an Introduction to AI course

description: KITE is a course-grounded intelligent tutoring system developed by Mragisha Jain et al.
title: KITE (Knowledge-Informed Tutoring Engine)

description: Four branded school-based anti-bullying programmes run by their respective developers and implementers for primary and secondary schools, using whole-school, classroom, individual, peer, online, and train-the-trainer interventions.
title: KiVa, Olweus Bullying Prevention Program (OBPP), NoTrap!, and ViSC
